faq.chooseASubscriptionAt4999EveryMonthOr: Choose a subscription at €49.99 every month or €104.99 every three months, or buy once: Legend Ultra is €999.99 and Legend Ultra + 2 Apex is €1,199.99. faq.howDoIAssignTheTwoApexRanks: How do I assign the two Apex ranks?
faq.signInOnTheAccountPageAsTheMinecraft: Sign in on the account page as the Minecraft player who received Legend Ultra + 2 Apex. Enter a different Minecraft username for each rank and confirm. Recipients must have joined 6b6t. Each assignment is permanent and cannot be transferred.
faq.whatIfIAlreadySubscribeToLegend: What if I already subscribe to Legend?
faq.yourExistingSubscriptionStaysUnchangedAf: Your existing subscription stays unchanged. After buying Legend Ultra, cancel the old subscription in your account billing portal to stop future charges. Cancelling that subscription does not remove Legend Ultra.
faq.writeACustomPrefixWithUpTo12Characters: Write a custom prefix with up to 12 characters and rename items for 1 XP level. Add a seal to chat and the player list, and set up to 3,000 homes. You get 3 gift slots and can share items in public chat every minute, up to 24 times a day. Legend Ultra includes every Legend feature.
faq.whatAreTheHomeAndTeleportLimits: What are the home and teleport limits?
faq.legendIncludes500HomesTheHomeAndTpaCoold: Legend includes 500 homes. The /home and /tpa cooldowns are 10 seconds, with a 3-second teleport execution time.
faq.legendIncludesNameAndChatColorsBalloonsP: Legend includes name and chat colors, balloons, particles, glow, /skin, /hat, /sit and /cigar. See the feature comparison for individual limits.
faq.whatCanIDoWithHotspots: What can I do with Hotspots?
faq.createAHotspotCustomizeItsNameAndGivePla: Create a Hotspot, customize its name, and give players a glow effect and a balloon.
faq.whatDoIGetInGroupChat: What do I get in group chat?
faq.yourGroupsCanHaveUpTo35PlayersAnd: Your groups can have up to 35 players, and you can be in 4 groups. Every group you lead shows "✦ Hosted by a Legend" and can use Legend-only name styles. You can choose up to 5 officers who can invite and kick. When you log in, you see up to 200 missed messages from the last 7 days. You can choose from 28 group chat sounds. Only you hear your sounds.
